stories.title: Long-read metagenomic and metatranscriptomic datasets from marine plankton
stories.description: Short-read sequencing (SRS) technologies, when applied to the study of environmental communities, present significant limitations that long-read sequencing (LRS) technologies are increasingly overcoming. However, the application of LRS for the integrated study of eukaryotic metagenome and metatranscriptome remains underexplored. Here, we present long-read metagenomic and metatranscriptomic sequencing datasets from four marine plankton samples collected during the Tara Pacific expedition. The metatranscriptome was characterized using high-depth poly(A)-selected cDNA-based Oxford Nanopore Technologies (ONT) PromethION sequencing, and the metagenome using PacBio Revio (HiFi) sequencing. These long-read datasets represent among the first publicly available resources to combine accurate metagenomic datasets with deeply sequenced metatranscriptomes from marine eukaryotic plankton, providing a valuable resource to study their transcript diversity and functional gene expression.
